description.text: The twelfth and last Sun & Moon set, released on 1 November 2019 with 271 cards: 236 and 35 secret rares. It has nine new TAG TEAM Pokémon-GX, among them Charizard & Braixen-GX, Venusaur & Snivy-GX, Blastoise & Piplup-GX, Solgaleo & Lunala-GX and the trio Arceus & Dialga & Palkia-GX, seven more Pokémon-GX, and the first TAG TEAM Supporters.
